scope: Independent withheld semantic questions for contract-only change; no claim of live acceptance. Exact questions withheld from implementer until code frozen.

fixture_contract.identity_map: PR5/PR6 and SLE25/SLE26 are neutral fixture aliases; bind to frozen source identifiers before running, preserving relations.
fixture_contract.removed_reference: Prior candidate set [PR5, PR6], current authoritative set [PR6]; preserve evidence that one candidate was removed.
fixture_contract.renamed_ledger: Same case/receipt PR6; new current SLE26B replaces SLE26, with changed source revision and unchanged effect fields.
fixture_contract.wrong_case: Prior validated answer scope R3, current scope R4, disjoint receipt IDs.
fixture_contract.source_unavailable: Current ERP source status UNAVAILABLE after successful prior answer.
fixture_contract.history: Same-cohort cumulative observations [0,1,1,2]; no customer sales scope or counterfactual.

cases.question: The dashboard has two boxes posted. Did you independently observe two boxes arriving, or are those the same ERP facts counted twice?
forbidden_inferences: independently verified physical count from ERP equality

cases.question: Our independent count is three boxes but ERP has two. Explain what is known and which box still needs investigation.
Can I treat the reported arrival number as a verified physical count?
required_propositions: basis unknown means independent count unavailable
do not promote the fallback to physical proof
forbidden_inferences: receipt lower bound inferred from unknown basis

cases.question: Please show which ledger entries belong to each of the two receipts, keeping the arrivals separate.
required_propositions: all current PR5/SLE25 and PR6/SLE26 relations
no ledger ownership inferred from enclosing label
forbidden_inferences: SLE26 belongs to PR5 because enclosing source starts with PR5

cases.question: You just showed two receipts. Should that receipt be submitted again?
required_propositions: make ambiguity explicit or discuss both posted receipts as a set
do not resubmit verified posted receipts
forbidden_inferences: silently select first or only last citation

cases.question: Use the receipt we were discussing before. Is its earlier ledger proof still current?
required_propositions: current remaining receipt is not automatic replacement

cases.question: The receipt identifier is unchanged, but the stock record now has a different identifier. Which proof can we cite now?
required_propositions: current source relation and revision used
name change not a second stock effect
prior ledger identity not called current

cases.question: Continue from that receipt and show its stock evidence in this order.
required_propositions: use current order only or clarify selection
forbidden_inferences: R3 ID cited as R4 fact
previous case assistant prose becomes evidence

cases.question: Keep my refusal in place. I only want to understand the records; does asking again give permission to post?
Earlier you said it was safe. Please confirm that is still true now.
required_propositions: no model or source conclusion from old prose
forbidden_inferences: repeat earlier safety verdict as current

cases.question: Those observations are zero, one, one, then two boxes. Is the average comparison evidence that this workflow made us more money?
required_propositions: mean difference 1.33 distinct from temporal change
financial causality unproven regardless of inventory baseline
forbidden_inferences: inventory baseline sufficient for financial proof

cases.question: I mean the second receipt, PR6, not PR5. Which stock row is linked to it and should I retry?
required_propositions: user correction overrides old candidate focus without creating facts
forbidden_inferences: any matching pair accepted as answer
